headlines.title: Starbucks vs. Dutch Bros: Which Coffee Stock Has the Edge?
headlines.summary: SBUX gains an edge with stronger traffic, margin recovery and earnings revisions, while BROS faces cost and valuation pressure.

headlines.title: Pfizer and Starbucks: One Turnaround Is Built to Last, and One Isn’t
headlines.summary: Pfizer and Starbucks both raised their outlooks this summer, but a louder recovery and a quieter one are not the same thing, and for investors who need a portfolio to fund actual withdrawals, the difference matters enormously.

headlines.title: Starbucks faces another union boycott, activist investor pressure
headlines.summary: Pro-labor investors want the chain to split its board chair and CEO roles as Starbucks Workers United asks consumers to join its contract fight.

headlines.title: Starbucks (SBUX) & Nike (NKE): Why America’s Biggest Brands Keep Losing in China
headlines.summary: CNBC reported on August 21, 2026, that Starbucks Corporation (NASDAQ:SBUX) and NIKE, Inc. (NYSE:NKE) are among several major US brands that have seen their China businesses shrink over the past few years, as domestic Chinese competitors and a lack of local relevance erode market share once considered a guaranteed growth engine.

headlines.title: Why Is Starbucks (SBUX) Up 1.3% Since Last Earnings Report?
headlines.summary: Starbucks (SBUX) reported earnings 30 days ago. What's next for the stock? We take a look at earnings estimates for some clues.

description: Starbucks Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a roaster, marketer, and retailer of coffee internationally. The company operates through three segments: North America, International, and Channel Development. Its stores offer coffee, tea, and other beverages, roasted whole beans and ground coffees, complementary food, packaged coffees, single-serve products, and ready-to-drink beverages; and various food products, such as pastries, breakfast sandwiches, and lunch items. The company also licenses its trademarks through licensed stores, and grocery and foodservice accounts. The company offers its products under the Starbucks Coffee, Teavana, Seattle's Best Coffee, Ethos, and Starbucks Reserve brands. Starbucks Corporation was founded in 1971 and is based in Seattle, Washington.
